text:
haruto: Hi everyone, I'm Haruto (haruto+contract@redwood.jp) starting today from Tokyo. Accepted the Okta invite but Drive access is missing because my Google Workspace alias is haruto@redwood.jp (no plus). 1Password shows "pending seat" and SMS MFA won't deliver (Japanese carrier roaming). I also need VPN cert for private repo access. Any temporary access options so I can start the onboarding tasks?

it-ryan: Welcome Haruto! Can you DM a personal email for a temp Drive share? We can do a short-lived 1Password guest vault and enable TOTP while SMS is flaky. For VPN, we can issue a short-lived client cert or scoped bastion access. Which do you prefer for immediacy: cert or bastion?

haruto: Thanks Ryan. DM'd haruto.personal@gmail.com. Cert would be easiest for my setup (I can install .p12). TOTP sounds good.

provision-bot: INC-3001 created by it-ryan: "Plus-address alias mismatch + 1Password seat + VPN cert" priority P2.

devex-sam: Sending a 72h 1Password guest vault link via DM (do not store long-term secrets). Also sharing onboarding Drive folder to haruto.personal@gmail.com. I'll paste the quick startup checklist in the DM: `ssh key`, `VPN cert install steps`, `starter ticket links`.

it-ryan: Generated a temporary VPN cert (expires 48h) and DM'd install instructions. Added haruto+contract@redwood.jp to contractors-temp group so you have basic infra console access while infra fixes the alias.

infra-chen: FYI plus-addressing isn't normalised in SCIM mapping for our workspace domains, so Okta created the profile with the literal + address. I'll add a canonicalization rule to strip plus-tags for redwood.jp and re-run the user sync. ETA 3-5 hours. After sync we'll re-run SSO so haruto@redwood.jp becomes the primary and Google alias will attach.

haruto: VPN cert installed and I can connect to the bastion. Drive + 1Password guest work too, thanks! Quick question: repo access workflow — who adds me to the GitHub team?

it-ryan: DM your GitHub handle and public SSH key and we'll invite you to the contractors team. We can also send an email invite to your personal gmail if you prefer until alias is canonical.

peopleops-mina: Welcome Haruto! People Ops sent the contractor agreement + onboarding checklist to your personal email. If you need expense access or local payment setup in JP please ping me. :wave:

infra-chen: INC-3001 status update  alias canonicalization change planned, re-sync after change, ETA 3-5h. 1Password seat request forwarded to licensing.

haruto: Appreciate the quick help everyone. I'll DM the SSH key and proceed with the tasks. Will keep using TOTP and the VPN cert until the SCIM fix lands. :thumbsup:
